blocks.content: Quiz: What header file is required to read and write files in C++?

<fstream>
Correct Answer!
The <fstream> file is used to read from and write to a file.

<ifstream>

ifstream is a class inside the <fstream> file and is used to read from a file.

<ofstream>

ofstream is a class inside the <fstream> file and is used to write to a file.
